overview: The Medford School Committee addressed administrative updates, grant acceptances, and program reports, including approving a technology infrastructure study and a high school band trip. The committee also referred a proposal to merge Medford High School and Medford Vocational Technical High School under one state code to a Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Tabled the minutes of the December 19, 2016 meeting to allow for an amendment dedicating the meeting.

items.title: Approval of Bills, Transfer of Funds, and Payrolls
items.summary: Approved payments for bills, fund transfers, and payrolls following clarification regarding travel reimbursements for an MASC conference.

items.title: Acceptance of Gift to MHS Robotics Team
items.summary: Accepted a $2,300 donation from MITEI to support registration fees and equipment for the Medford High School robotics team.

items.title: Approval of MHS Band Trip to Orlando, Florida
items.summary: Approved an April field trip for the Medford High School band to participate in Disney Magic Music Days in Orlando, Florida.

items.title: Tufts Neighborhood Service Fund Grant Acceptance
items.summary: Accepted a $250 Tufts Neighborhood Service Fund grant awarded to the Medford Family Resources Coalition.

items.title: Merger of Medford High School and Medford Vocational Technical High School Codes
items.summary: Referred a proposal to formally merge Medford High School and Medford Vocational Technical High School into a single state administrative code to a Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Report on Vocational and Science Department Grants
items.summary: Received a report detailing grant funding awarded for joint vocational and science department initiatives, including robotics, clean energy, and adult education programs.

items.title: Report on Elementary Science Curriculum (2017–2020)
items.summary: Received a report on professional development and curriculum development plans designed to align elementary science instruction with updated state frameworks.

items.title: Report on WIDA Access Testing for ELL Students
items.summary: Placed on file an update regarding mandated annual English proficiency testing for approximately 425 English Language Learner students across the district.

items.title: Technology Infrastructure Study for Capital Planning and E-Rate Funds
items.summary: Approved up to $33,150 for TechEdge to perform a network infrastructure study required to secure federal E-rate funding.

items.title: Appointment of MPS Public Records Access Officer
items.summary: Approved the appointment of Alicia Palmer as the district's Public Records Access Officer to comply with revised state public records laws.

items.title: Report on Outdoor Recess Policy and Weather Conditions
items.summary: Placed on file a report maintaining building principals' discretion to determine indoor or outdoor recess based on local weather conditions.

items.title: Financial Report
items.summary: Tabled the biweekly financial report until the next committee meeting.

items.title: Resolutions and New Business
items.summary: Approved condolence resolutions for deceased community and family members and congratulated a MHS graduate on national team athletic selection before entering executive session.
